5900-6720-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-6720-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

618-1734-4247.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1580-3967-4871-6248.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2011-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

338-1308-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-1308-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4050-6752-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6752-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

277-280-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-280-5449-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1887-4636-5770-6291.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Beast and Thopter enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

851-4636-4772-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

2104-6333-6335.manaNeeded: {1}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2104-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
2104-6333-6335.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1987-4423-4872-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4872-5913.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

851-1887-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating two 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

323-2760-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
323-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

647-1170-1328-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
647-1170-1328-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1794-2034-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-2034-4424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

97-1308-2034-2308.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-1308-2034-2308.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

377-1381-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Shieldmate, adding {W}.
When Nyxborn Shieldmate dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Nyxborn Shieldmate on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Nyxborn Shieldmate from your library.
Cast Nyxborn Shieldmate by paying {W}.
Repeat.

1374-3136-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Changeling Outcast, adding {B}.
Cast Changeling Outcast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

155-586-4050-5105.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {W}.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W}, returning Priest of Gix to hand.
Repeat.

3617-3742-4125.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
3617-3742-4125.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that is tapped and attacking.
Shipwreck Dowser enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
